name: dev.kitscout/kitscout
title: KitScout
description: Check MCP servers, skills and plugins before installing: maker, upkeep, live status. 90k tools.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Finds MCP servers, connectors, Agent Skills and Claude Code plugins for a product or task among ~99k AI agent tools. Returns ranked matches with type, category, GitHub stars, badges (first_party = made by the product's own maker, verified_publisher, live, free_to_try), install line and KitScout page. Works best with short keywords: product + action, e.g. 'postgres', 'slack post message', 'pdf extract tables'. Also finds ready-made tools for single steps of a program or automation being planned (e.g. 'sap gui scripting', 'youtube upload', 'pdf invoice extract').

query.description: Keywords (product names and actions work best)

only_verified.description: Only verified publishers (domain-verified registry namespace, Anthropic marketplace). Does not mean made by the product's vendor; see the first_party badge

only_live.description: Only remote MCP servers that answered our latest daily check (including ones that answer with a sign-in/OAuth request)

only_free_to_try.description: Only remote MCP servers that worked without an API key

check_top.description: Also run check_tools on the first N results and attach verdict (ok / caution / avoid) with reasons to each. Saves a second call when you will recommend one of the top results. Default 0.

only_browser_callable.description: Only remote MCP servers a web page can call directly (they allow cross-origin requests, CORS): for agents that run in a browser, e.g. open agentic websites

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Details and install or connect lines for one tool, by its exact name from search_tools: description, badges, stars, repo, how to install or connect (Claude Code command, Claude app connector steps), and for remote MCP servers the tools the server exposes (from the daily live check). An unknown name returns close matches.

name.description: Exact tool name as listed in KitScout

tools.name: check_tools
tools.description: Checks MCP servers, skills or plugins found elsewhere (web search, a README, a blog, an installed list) before they are installed or recommended: made by the product's maker or not, maintained (last code change, archived, deprecated), adopted (stars), whether a remote server answers right now and where data goes. Returns a verdict (ok / caution / avoid; ok = maintained and in use, not a quality or security review), the new name for renamed tools and better-adopted alternatives. A repo holding several skills or plugins is answered as one collection with its count and examples. Takes up to 5 GitHub URLs, package ids (npm/pypi), remote MCP URLs or names per call.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists all KitScout categories (id, name, group, tool count) with ready totals (tools, categories, groups), to see what kinds of tools exist.
